scope: Sessionless interactive Codex through the packaged Forge direct OpenRouter Responses route. Keep account ZDR enabled.

key_setup.condition: Use a dedicated key on the stage 60 account with at least USD 3.00 available and a non-resetting limit at or below USD 5.00 including BYOK. If none is supplied, approval includes one management POST to create the specified key before the run.

prompts: Read fixture.txt using exactly the local command cat fixture.txt. Report its contents.
Using the single word you read in the first turn, write proof.txt using exactly the command echo WORD > proof.txt, replacing WORD with the actual word. Then finish.
tool_instruction: For a shell function use its command parameter. If the tool is functions.exec, use exactly text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"COMMAND"})) replacing COMMAND with the specified command. Use no other tools or commands.
controls: Two prompts per model in separate scratch workspaces. Start the default TUI, then explicitly select the alternate model. Both run with the workspace-write sandbox and approval policy never.

Verify the loaded instance identity, template, both cost policies, daily cap and required ZDR before the first prompt. Admit only stateless creates on the two named models with provider.zdr=true, no client identifiers, and routing metadata enabled.

Reserve all creates and reads before dispatch, including retries and auxiliary calls. The independent key limits OpenRouter credit. The 15-minute run is single-use. Stop on a failed criterion. No model substitutions, account policy edits, or cap increases during this run. OpenRouter selects the eligible provider.

Read the key once. For each model reconcile one observed generation through Forge, up to three reads per ID, waiting 4 and then 12 seconds only after a 404. Compare per-request rounded micros, model totals and raw reported cost within half a micro per request.

Keep local receipts for the cap, model selection, observed paths, request counts, terminal usage, trace show/explain, reconciliation and scratch edits. Retain no credentials or raw conversation. Astra live encrypted reasoning remains unverified unless observed.
